name: 115.简

basedOn.note: User asked to continue with other planned optimization areas before separately validating Test15. Test16 therefore keeps the Test15 offline center intact and starts the account/capacity/settings slice without marking Test15 as passed.

features: add a dedicated account/settings center while preserving the original 115Account page for login, QR scan and account switching
show current login state, username/avatar/VIP information when exposed by the current 115Api client
show total/used/remaining storage and usage percentage when client.getInfo is available
provide compact direct entries to File Management, Offline Center, Recycle Bin and refresh
show the current offline save-directory name without exposing CID or internal mode on the normal page
add a separate diagnostics/advanced page for build state, cached directory IDs, UI state and safe reset actions
carry Test15 offline_center_v3 for users upgrading directly from Test13/Test14

evidence.driverGetUser: SheltonZhu/115driver GetUser returns UserInfo including user_name, face, user_id, vip and expire.
evidence.driverGetInfo: SheltonZhu/115driver GetInfo returns space_info.all_total/all_use/all_remain plus login device info.
evidence.compatibility: The account center reads camelCase and raw JSON-style field aliases defensively because the current 115Api wrapper normalizes several driver objects.

safety.networkRequests: account center makes at most one getUser and one getInfo request on explicit page load

validationTarget: home 账号与设置 entry opens the new center, or the original account page shows a fallback center entry
existing QR/login/account-switch functions remain available through 登录与账号管理
capacity information renders when supported by the installed 115Api
offline save directory shows a human-readable name only
diagnostics page does not expose cookies or credentials
Test15 offline center, search, file management, recycle bin and external magnet flow do not regress
